identity.tiles.oidcText: Sign in with any OpenID Connect provider
identity.tiles.defaultRoleText: Automatically grants a role to authenticated users
identity.ldap.title: LDAP
identity.ldap.description: Manage LDAP server connections for user authentication
identity.ldap.name: Name
identity.ldap.emptyHint: Click "Create LDAP Server" to add one
identity.ldap.aboutServersText: LDAP servers are used for user authentication and authorization. The order determines which server is tried first. Drag servers to reorder them.
identity.ldap.aboutText: LDAP (Lightweight Directory Access Protocol) allows you to integrate Astrum Repository with external user directories for authentication. You can configure multiple LDAP servers and they will be queried in order until a user is found.
identity.ldap.orderText: LDAP servers are queried in order during authentication. Drag servers to reorder them.
identity.ldap.deleteText: Are you sure you want to delete the LDAP server "{name}"? Users authenticated through this server will no longer be able to log in.
identity.ldap.createText: Configure connection and user mapping settings
identity.ldap.nameHelp: A unique name for this LDAP server
identity.ldap.protocolHelp: Connection protocol. Use ldaps for encrypted connections.
identity.ldap.hostHelp: LDAP server hostname or IP address
identity.ldap.trustStoreHelp: Use the Astrum trust store for SSL certificate validation
identity.ldap.searchBaseHelp: The base DN to search for users
identity.ldap.realmHelp: The SASL realm for DIGEST-MD5 or CRAM-MD5 authentication
identity.ldap.usernameHelp: The DN of the user to bind with for searches
identity.ldap.passwordKeep: Leave blank to keep the existing password
identity.ldap.templateHelp: Select a template to pre-fill common LDAP configurations
identity.ldap.userBaseDnHelp: The relative DN where user objects are found (e.g. ou=people). This value will have the Search base DN value appended to form the full User search base DN
identity.ldap.userSubtreeHelp: Search the entire subtree for users
identity.ldap.objectClassHelp: LDAP object class for users (e.g., inetOrgPerson, person)
identity.ldap.userIdHelp: Attribute containing the username (e.g., uid, sAMAccountName)
identity.ldap.realNameHelp: Attribute containing the display name (e.g., cn, displayName)
identity.ldap.passwordAttributeHelp: If this field is left blank the user will be authenticated against a bind with the LDAP server
identity.ldap.groupsAsRolesHelp: Enable to map LDAP groups to Astrum roles
identity.ldap.memberOfHelp: Set this to the attribute used to store the attribute which holds groups DN in the user object
identity.ldap.groupBaseDnHelp: The relative DN where group objects are found (e.g. ou=Group). This value will have the Search base DN value appended to form the full Group search base DN
identity.ldap.groupSubtreeHelp: Search the entire subtree for groups
identity.ldap.passwordForConnection: A password is required to verify the LDAP server connection. Enter the password for the service account used to connect to LDAP.
identity.ldap.passwordForMapping: A password is required to verify the LDAP user mapping. Enter the password for the service account used to connect to LDAP.
identity.ldap.loginText: Enter credentials to verify that a user can authenticate with this LDAP server.
identity.ldap.hostInvalid: Not a valid hostname or IP address
identity.ldap.usernameRequired: Username is required for an authenticated connection
identity.ldap.passwordRequired: Password is required for an authenticated connection
identity.ldap.timeoutRange: Must be a number between 1 and 3600
identity.ldap.notNegative: Must be a number of 0 or greater
identity.ldap.memberOfRequired: Group member of attribute is required
identity.oidc.title: OpenID Connect
identity.oidc.redirectUriHelp: Register this redirect URI for the client in your identity provider.
identity.oidc.issuerUrlHelp: For example https://sso.example.com. Endpoints and keys are read from its .well-known/openid-configuration; the endpoint fields below override them.
identity.oidc.clientIdHelp: The client ID registered with your identity provider
identity.oidc.clientSecretHelp: The client secret for authentication. Leave empty for a public client that uses PKCE only.
identity.oidc.clientSecretStored: A client secret is stored. Leave the field empty to keep it.
identity.oidc.authorizationUrlHelp: The authorization endpoint of your identity provider
identity.oidc.logoutUrlHelp: The logout endpoint of your identity provider
identity.oidc.tokenUrlHelp: The token endpoint of your identity provider
identity.oidc.jwksUrlHelp: The JWKS endpoint for token verification
identity.oidc.trustStoreInsecure: You cannot enable this feature because your remote storage is not using a secure URL; there is no SSL certificate available.
identity.oidc.trustStoreHelp: Validate the identity provider's certificate with the Astrum Repository truststore
identity.oidc.usernameClaimHelp: The claim that contains the username
identity.oidc.firstNameClaimHelp: The claim that contains the first name
identity.oidc.lastNameClaimHelp: The claim that contains the last name
identity.oidc.emailClaimHelp: The claim that contains the email address
identity.oidc.groupsClaimHelp: The claim that contains the group memberships
identity.oidc.jwsAlgorithmHelp: The signing algorithm used by the IDP (e.g., RS256)
identity.oidc.jwksHelp: Optional JSON Web Key Set for offline verification
identity.oidc.authorizationParamsHelp: Custom parameters for authorization requests (JSON format)
identity.oidc.tokenParamsHelp: Custom parameters for token requests (JSON format)
identity.oidc.exactClaimsHelp: Claims that must match exactly (JSON format)
identity.oidc.badJson: The field "{field}" must contain a valid JSON object with string values
identity.defaultRole.title: Default Role
identity.defaultRole.description: Automatically grants a role to authenticated users.
identity.defaultRole.roleHelp: The role which is automatically granted to authenticated users
identity.defaultRole.missing: The role {role} no longer exists, so nobody receives it. Select another role.
identity.defaultRole.removeText: Authenticated users will no longer receive the role {role} automatically.
